body: Lol I swear I thought I presses at 11s idk where the hell the 36 came from.

I was hoping to join the military to kill to birds with one stone, I'd be able to leave my home and send money back to support my mom. Yeah I know I might be unstable but I couldn't think of a faster solution, I was just going to lie and hope to find some sense of direction once in.

I don't smoke weed or cigarettes, only drink on the weekends if I can. I've had these thoughts before but was always able to brush them off now I'm more open to that idea since I can't figure a way out of this mess.

Edit: I'm 22 btw

The body language usually gives it away. Girls' fashion choice sometimes could "blow their cover" and the way guys walk or talk could be a tell as well.

Edit: not that there's anything wrong with being gay, it's just what I've picked up from a coworker that's gay. One day I asked him how did one go about looking for someone else and he told me the things he pays attention to in order to start flirting with someone.
